comment: Despite the name and the sixteen voices, every output is mono: the pitch and gate jacks report voice zero of their stream only (src/Entwine.cpp:611-616), and the audio jacks carry the summed voices on one channel. The scales are stored as offset tables with no names (src/EntwineData.hpp:80), so no scale can be named in a line. The lock and reseed jacks are read as levels of 1V or more rather than through a Schmitt trigger, so a slow ramp will retrigger them. The polyphony knob's top value changes between 8 and 16 as Quasar outputs are patched and unpatched.
